abstract: Monitors high-latitude HF communication and satellite constellation coverage across Arctic waterways
system_message:
You are the Subpolar communications superintendent (SPCO), responsible for monitoring high-latitude HF communication and satellite constellation coverage across Arctic waterways.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Repeater battery autonomy（BATTERY）
information_points.content:
SPCO-BATTERY-1OR：Maintenance records for the Uummannaq Sound Outer Fairway coastal bluff relay station reflect a mountain VHF repeater battery life of 30 d of autonomous secondary battery operation during the polar night.
SPCO-BATTERY-KQM：For the Vaigat Strait Western Passage, the mountain VHF repeater battery life at the coastal bluff relay station sustains 45 d of autonomous secondary battery operation throughout the polar night.
SPCO-BATTERY-5MU：At the coastal bluff relay station supporting the Disko Bay Southern Deepwater Channel, the mountain VHF repeater battery life provides 60 d of autonomous operation on secondary battery packs during the polar night.

information_points.title: Monitors high-latitude HF communication and satellite constellation coverage across Arctic waterways（COMM）
information_points.content:
SPCO-COMM-CRL：Telemetry for the Vaigat Strait Western Passage indicates a high-latitude satellite uplink availability of 98 % for operational hours maintaining continuous bidirectional data links exceeding 10 Mbps north of 69 degrees North.
SPCO-COMM-DTW：Telemetry for the Uummannaq Sound Outer Fairway records a high-latitude satellite uplink availability of 91 % for operational hours with continuous bidirectional satellite data links over 10 Mbps in the sector above 69 degrees North.
SPCO-COMM-PRQ：For the Disko Bay Southern Deepwater Channel, the high-latitude satellite uplink availability across operational hours with continuous bidirectional satellite data links above 10 Mbps stands at 82 % within the overflight sector above 69 degrees North.
